note: The spec binder (2026-11-18, after the student asked for reference sheets that differ by implant model rather than by character). Story: the doctor kept Kessler's spec binder when they were fired, and it holds the factory normal of every model Kessler built, licensed or copied on the street. A patient is a set of parts, one model per slot (cases/<id>.json parts): eye_l, eye_r, hands, port, voice. The reference sheet is assembled from the models a patient wears (scripts/core/case_db.gd sheet_for), so two patients with the same models get the same sheet and a new patient only needs models from this file. baseline is the body the sheet shows between patients. tag: what is printed under the row's label; a code name (KITE, VX-9) stays in English in every language, and a tag that describes (NATURAL, STREET, MIL-SPEC) is translated (data/lang/<code>/parts.json). eyes: kind is which close-up art family draws it (natural, optic, combat, display); pupil is what light should do to it: tightens (a natural pupil), shutter (a combat shutter that snaps tight) or none (nothing to tighten); both is the eyes row when both eyes are this model and fine what is ordinary for them; one and fine_one are this model's part of eyes_mixed when the two eyes differ (tag_l or tag_r names the implant beside a natural eye, tag_two stands for two different implants). Every eye model follows the light. hands: limit_ms is how long a steady hand of this model may take to let go of the grip bar (the sheet's hands normal, the close-up's LIMIT mark, case_db's check of rows.hands). Any model may give a normal of its own in place of the sheet's. Nobody has playtested any of it.

natural.both: Pupils tighten in light. Both follow it.

kite.both: No pupils, nothing tightens. Both follow.

iris.both: Screens, no pupils. Both follow the light.

talon.both: Shutters snap tight in light. Both follow.

scan.both: Lenses, no pupils. Both follow the light.
scan.fine: A red glow, a faint tick.

loader.fine: Locks up now and then, twitches.

street.fine: Scuffs, burnt pins, cheap cable marks.

milspec.normal: Calm skin at the plate. No dark threads.

vx.fine: A st-stutter, a skipped word, nerves.
